summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting the election of shareholder representatives to its board of directors. The corporate assembly elected Jarle Roth as new chair, replacing Jon Erik Reinhardsen who resigned; other board members were re-elected. No terms such as price, premium, or dates of a transaction were disclosed. The board recommendation and advisors are not mentioned. This is a non-US filing, equivalent to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure/election announcement. The change is effective July 1, 2026. Watch for any strategic shifts under the new chair.
